class.name: HEGoCurveOutput
class.brief_description: Turns the curves of a cooked HDA into [Path3D] nodes under [code]Outputs/[/code].
class.description: The curve geometry itself is built by [HEGoCurveBuilder]; this only decides where the nodes go and reuses existing ones so anything referencing a path keeps working.

method.name: output_phase
method.description: Name of the cook phase this handler is timed under.

method.name: handle
method.description: Fetches the cooked curves and builds the Path3D output.

constants.constant: Prim attribute naming the node a curve should end up at.
Folder generated curves go into when a curve does not name its own path.
